entries.finding: security design 8.2: a diagnostics.run finding reports that the custody log could not be written (review 6065710236 N7, L3)
entries.reason: no core serves diagnostics.run on this base, so there is no finding list to add it to; the account calls already carry audit_unavailable and the CLI prints the note

entries.finding: security design 8.2: recovery closes a started record whose pid the OS has given to another process, and decides liveness only for records written in its own process namespace (review 6066498814 Y4; 6067671766 L1)
entries.reason: 8.2 fixes the field set of a started record; recovery needs the starter's start identity and its namespace in that record, and 8.2 must name them before a record may carry them
